title: Canonical source-ordered observation inspection v1.1
description: Closed inspection-only snapshots of supported observational source/method families. Runtime admission additionally requires canonical rebuilding from current catalogs; schema admission alone establishes neither canonical provenance nor scientific comparability. Snapshot digests identify bundled metadata, not source artifact bytes.
